title: Trace Privacy Filter Engine with Differential-Privacy Tokenization for Exports
creator: Anita Kapoor
description: Build a pluggable Trace Privacy Filter Engine that sits in the export pipeline and enforces tenant-configurable data-masking and differential-privacy tokenization policies before traces are sent to third-party backends (OTLP/Tempo/Jaeger). Goals: reduce PII/leakage risk in exported spans, make exports compliant with regional privacy rules, and allow reversible encryption for enterprise customers that require debugability. The engine must be low-latency, support per-tenant policy evaluation, integrate with our existing exporter pipeline, and expose observability for filtered/span-loss metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Policy DSL defined and documented; operators can express field-level masking, tokenization, and noise budgets per tenant.
Filter chain implemented as a configurable middleware in exporter path; supports OTLP/Tempo/Jaeger outputs without changing exporter semantics (status codes, ack behavior).

Differential-privacy tokenization prototype: adds configurable Laplace/Gaussian noise to numeric attributes and k-anonymity style bucketing for categorical high-cardinality attributes; validated via unit tests and statistical checks.
Reversible encryption option implemented using customer KMS keys for spans marked as reversible; key usage audited and logs emitted to audit sink.
End-to-end benchmarks show <5% p99 export latency regression at typical load and no regression in throughput targets for Dedicated pool profiles.
Operator console shows filtered-span-rates, noise-budget-consumption, per-tenant policy hits, and a drilldown to examples (sanitized) for QA.
Security review completed and signoff provided in ticket comments.
tasks: Design policy DSL and policy evaluation engine (spec doc and examples).
Implement filter middleware and integrate with otlp-exporter and tempo/jaeger shims.
Integrate KMS-based reversible encryption and audit logging hook.
Implement differential-privacy primitives and statistical sanity tests.
Add metrics (filtered_spans_total, filtered_bytes_total, noise_budget_used) and dashboards.
Write e2e tests with synthetic PII-laden traces and golden export assertions.
Run load tests on dedicated pool images and iterate on perf hotspots.
Document admin APIs, migration plan, and upgrade notes for Private customers.
notes: We need to decide default policy for OSS vs enterprise tenants: OSS should default to irreversible masking, enterprise can opt into reversible encryption with KMS.
Interplay with sampling: filtered spans should still contribute to sampling metrics; ensure tracing continuity when we redact trace attributes used for trace correlation.
Consider adding a transparent preserves-list for trace-context headers to avoid breaking downstream correlation.
Rollout plan: start as opt-in feature behind feature flag; pilot with two internal tenants before broader rollout.
